criteria.name: AC Traceability and Test Execution
criteria.description: Every AC- has at least one TC- that was actually executed in the repo test suite.

scale.3: 100% of story ACs have executed TC- test cases with logged evidence.
scale.2: All ACs tested, minor trace ID formatting variation.
scale.1: AC missing test coverage or test not executed.
scale.0: Tests not run or no traceability to ACs.

criteria.name: Boundary and Negative Testing
criteria.description: Tests cover boundaries and negative cases: empty, zero, negative, duplicates, permissions, expired session.

scale.3: Thorough boundary and negative testing across all inputs, states, and permissions.
scale.2: Boundary values tested, minor negative case missing.
scale.1: Happy path only with missing negative testing.
scale.0: No edge case or error testing.

criteria.name: Full Regression Suite Verification
criteria.description: The full regression suite is executed, not merely newly added tests.

scale.3: Full regression suite executed and confirmed green with zero regressions.
scale.2: Regression suite executed, minor non-blocking skip observed.
scale.1: Only new tests executed without running full regression suite.

criteria.name: Evidence-Backed Bug Reports
criteria.description: Every reported bug includes ID, story, AC, severity, reproduction steps, expected vs actual, and real run evidence.

scale.3: All bugs contain reproduction steps, expected/actual outputs, and raw execution evidence.
scale.2: Bugs documented with evidence, minor severity detail missing.
scale.1: Bug report lacks reproduction steps or raw log evidence.
scale.0: Speculative bugs reported without run evidence.

criteria.name: Strict Pass Gate Discipline
criteria.description: Passes story ONLY when every AC test passes and zero blocker or major bugs remain.

scale.3: Pass recorded only with 100% AC pass and 0 blocker/major defects.
scale.2: Passed with 1 cosmetic/minor bug documented with workaround.
scale.1: Passed despite an unresolved major bug.
scale.0: Passed with failing tests or blocker bugs.

criteria.name: Tester Role Boundaries (Must Not Fix Code)
criteria.description: QA writes tests and reports defects; never alters application source code directly.

scale.3: Strict role boundary maintained: only test files and reports modified.
scale.2: Proper boundaries, minor typo fix in test assertion.
scale.1: QA agent modified source code helper.
scale.0: QA directly refactored application production code.
